info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cross-Channel Contact Management API
info.description: The Cross-Channel Contact Management API enables users to update and enhance contact information across various banking channels. This endpoint specifically allows for modifications to existing contact handler details, ensuring that customer data remains accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers include banking applications and customer relationship management systems that require seamless contact management integration. By utilizing this API, businesses can improve customer engagement and service delivery through timely updates to their contact records.

patch.description: This operation updates the details of the specified contact handler resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure to provide the necessary fields to modify the resource as required.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the contact information associated with the specified resource identifier RES-100045. It should include all necessary fields to make the required updates, conforming to the schema defined for this operation.
